title: Картка інформаційної одиниці
fields_and_relations: recorded_work/fei, title/incipit, порядок, учасники, терміни й source_label, сегменти.
required_interaction: Перемикання підтипу/класифікація з перевіркою D; повторне виконання лишається окремою одиницею.

implementation.view_model: WF-07: material list → description tabs with contextual dialogs; source-faithful profiles, documented sessions and separate ordered units, participant functions, geographic roles, scoped draft classifications with evidence, pinned representations/segments, exact-version review handoff WF-08 review links expose decisions, accepted relations and classification states.
limitations: Browser-local prototype; classifications use the explicit WF-08 human review. No automatic graph merge, authoritative vocabulary import or rights approval. Specialist D13 semantic relations and D11/D20 regional taxonomy remain separate gaps.
implementation.state_storage: Shared normalized browser store; fixture version 9
permissions: field.write or catalog.write in archive scope; vocabulary.write for terms
implementation.atomicity: Authorize, expected revision, clone, validate, hash, commit. No partial mutation on failure.
implementation.field_view: R01: field record content, participant codes, edit dialog and return to its session; R02 archival tabs retained.
